test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following graph shows the ratio of the imports and exports of an industry during the period from 2005 to 2011. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a1757a7fc79b0317060c2b29bafb377a3d9801355bb2268e757a4f1190861dc.png] 

If the imports of the company in 2009 were 420 crore, then how much were the exports?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a1757a7fc79b0317060c2b29bafb377a3d9801355bb2268e757a4f1190861dc.png] 

Imports in 2009 = 420 crore

**Calculation:**

Let the export for the company in 2009 be x.

According to the ratio,

⇒ (420)/(x)=1.4

⇒ x = (420)/(1.4)

⇒ x = 300

**Therefore, the export for the company in 2009 was 300 crore.**
